newsitem.title: FRANCE: FRENCH STOCKS CLOSE 1.17 PERCENT HIGHER, AFTER ROLLERCOASTER SESSION.
newsitem.headline: FRENCH STOCKS CLOSE 1.17 PERCENT HIGHER, AFTER ROLLERCOASTER SESSION.

text.p: French shares closed 1.17 percent lower after a roller coaster session which saw a morning all-time high followed by a steep fall on fears of new taxes on companies.
* CAC-40 index down 34.59, or 1.17 percent, at 2,909.45. Fresh all-time high at 2,986.09.
* CAC-40 July futures 2,917 vs 2,945 at Tuesdays close.
* Volume was a heavy 11.7 billion francs
